verses.en: And it came to pass that after I, the Lord God, had driven them out, that Adam began to till the earth, and to have dominion over all the beasts of the field, and to eat his bread by the sweat of his brow, as I the Lord had commanded him. And Eve, also, his wife, did labor with him.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ua mavae ona tutuli ese o i laua e A’u, o le Alii le Atua, sa amata ona galueaiina e Atamu le eleele, ma pule i manu vaefa uma o le fanua, ma ’ai ana meaai ma le afu o lona muaulu, e pei ona poloaiina ai o ia e A’u o le Alii. Ma sa galue foi Eva, lana ava, faatasi ma ia.

verses.en: And Adam knew his wife, and she bare unto him sons and daughters, and they began to multiply and to replenish the earth.
verses.sm: Ma sa iloa e Atamu lana ava, ma sa fanau e ia ia te ia o atalii ma afafine, ma sa amata ona latou fanafanau ma uluuluola i le lalolagi.

verses.en: And from that time forth, the sons and daughters of Adam began to divide two and two in the land, and to till the land, and to tend flocks, and they also begat sons and daughters.
verses.sm: Ma e mai lena taimi ma agai atu i le lumanai, sa amata ona vaevae taitoalua o atalii ma afafine o Atamu i le laueleele, ma e galueaiina le laueleele, ma tausi lafu manu, ma sa latou fananauina foi atalii ma afafine.

verses.en: And Adam and Eve, his wife, called upon the name of the Lord, and they heard the voice of the Lord from the way toward the Garden of Eden, speaking unto them, and they saw him not; for they were shut out from his presence.
verses.sm: Ma o Atamu ma Eva, lana ava, sa valaau atu i le suafa o le Alii, ma sa laua faalogoina le siufofoga o le Alii mai le ala agai i le Faatoaga o Etena, ua fetalai mai ia i laua, ae sa laua lē vaai atu ia te ia; aua sa punitia i laua mai ona luma.

verses.en: And he gave unto them commandments, that they should worship the Lord their God, and should offer the firstlings of their flocks, for an offering unto the Lord. And Adam was obedient unto the commandments of the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma sa tuu mai e ia ia i laua poloaiga, ia la tapuai atu i le Alii lo laua Atua, ma ofoina atu uluai manu o a laua lafu, mo se taulaga i le Alii. Ma sa usiusitai Atamu i poloaiga a le Alii.

w.en: to the commandments of the Lord;

verses.en: And after many days an angel of the Lord appeared unto Adam, saying: Why dost thou offer sacrifices unto the Lord? And Adam said unto him: I know not, save the Lord commanded me.
verses.sm: Ma ina ua mavae aso e tele, sa oo mai se agelu a le Alii ia Atamu, ua fetalai mai: Aisea ua e osi atu ai taulaga i le Alii? Ma sa fai atu Atamu ia te ia: Ou te lē iloa, ae na poloaiina ai a’u e le Alii.

verses.en: And then the angel spake, saying: This thing is a similitude of the sacrifice of the Only Begotten of the Father, which is full of grace and truth.
verses.sm: Ma ona fetalai mai lea o le agelu, e faapea mai: O lenei mea o se faatusa lea o le taulaga a le Toatasi na Fanaua e le Tamā, o lē ua tumu i le alofa tunoa ma le upumoni.

verses.en: Wherefore, thou shalt do all that thou doest in the name of the Son, and thou shalt repent and call upon God in the name of the Son forevermore.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ia e faia mea uma e te faia i le suafa o le Alo, ma ia e salamo ma valaau atu i le Atua i le suafa o le Alo e faavavau.

verses.en: And in that day the Holy Ghost fell upon Adam, which beareth record of the Father and the Son, saying: I am the Only Begotten of the Father from the beginning, henceforth and forever, that as thou hast fallen thou mayest be redeemed, and all mankind, even as many as will.
verses.sm: Ma i lena aso na afio ifo ai le Agaga Paia i luga o Atamu, o lē e molimau i le Tamā ma le Alo, ua fetalai mai: O A’u o le Toatasi na Fanaua e le Tamā mai le amataga, mai le taimi nei ma le agai i luma ma le faavavau, aua talu ai ona ua e pa’ū ia mafai ona laveaiina oe, ma tagata uma, le toatele lava e mananao i ai.

verses.en: And in that day Adam blessed God and was filled, and began to prophesy concerning all the families of the earth, saying: Blessed be the name of God, for because of my transgression my eyes are opened, and in this life I shall have joy, and again in the flesh I shall see God.
verses.sm: Ma i lena aso na viia ai e Atamu le Atua ma sa faatumuina, ma sa amata ona vavalo e uiga i aiga uma o le lalolagi, ua fai mai: Ia viia lava le suafa o le Atua, aua ona o la’u solitulafono ua pupula ai o’u mata, ma o le a ou maua i le olaga lenei le olioli, ma o le a ou toe vaai i le Atua i le tino.

w.en: all the kindreds of the earth.

verses.en: And Eve, his wife, heard all these things and was glad, saying: Were it not for our transgression we never should have had seed, and never should have known good and evil, and the joy of our redemption, and the eternal life which God giveth unto all the obedient.
verses.sm: Ma o Eva, lana ava, sa faalogo atu i nei mea uma ma sa fiafia, ua fai mai: Ana lē seanoa la ta solitulafono po ua lē maua e i taua ni fanau, ma po ua lē mafai ona ta iloa le lelei ma le leaga, ma le olioli o le togiolaina o i ta’ua, ma le ola e faavavau ua tuu mai e le Atua ia i latou uma o e e usiusitai.

verses.en: And Adam and Eve blessed the name of God, and they made all things known unto their sons and their daughters.
verses.sm: Ma sa viia e Atamu ma Eva le suafa o le Atua, ma sa la faailoa atu mea uma i o laua atalii ma afafine.

verses.en: And Satan came among them, saying: I am also a son of God; and he commanded them, saying: Believe it not; and they believed it not, and they loved Satan more than God. And men began from that time forth to be carnal, sensual, and devilish.
verses.sm: Ona sau ai lea o Satani i totonu o i latou, ua fai mai: O a’u foi o se atalii o le Atua; ma sa ia faatonu mai ia te i latou, ua fai mai: Aua tou te talitonu i ia mea; ma sa latou lē talitonu i ai, ma sa sili atu lo latou alolofa ia Satani nai lo le Atua. Ma e sa amata mai i lena taimi ma agai atu i le lumanai ona faaletino, faalelagona, ma faatiapolo tagata.

verses.en: And the Lord God called upon men by the Holy Ghost everywhere and commanded them that they should repent;
verses.sm: Ma sa valaau atu le Alii le Atua i tagata uma i soo se mea e ala i le Agaga Paia ma poloaiina i latou e ao ina latou salamo;

verses.en: And as many as believed in the Son, and repented of their sins, should be saved; and as many as believed not and repented not, should be damned; and the words went forth out of the mouth of God in a firm decree; wherefore they must be fulfilled.
verses.sm: Ma o le toatele sa talitonu i le Alo, ma salamo i a latou agasala, o le a faaolaina; ma o le toatele sa lē talitonu ma lē salamo, o le a tausalaina; ma sa tulei atu afioga mai le fofoga o le Atua i se poloaiga mau; o le mea lea, o le a faataunuuina lava i latou.

verses.en: And Adam and Eve, his wife, ceased not to call upon God. And Adam knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bare Cain, and said: I have gotten a man from the Lord; wherefore he may not reject his words. But behold, Cain hearkened not, saying: Who is the Lord that I should know him?
verses.sm: Ma o Atamu ma Eva, lana ava, sa lē tu’ua le valaau atu i le Atua. Ma sa iloa e Atamu lana ava o Eva, ma sa to o ia ma fanauina Kaino, ma sa fai mai: Ua ou maua se tama tane mai le Alii; o le mea lea o le a lē mafai ai e ia ona teena ana afioga. Ae faauta, sa lē faalogo Kaino, ua fai mai: O ai le Alii e tatau ai ona ou iloa o ia?

verses.en: And she again conceived and bare his brother Abel. And Abel hearkened unto the voice of the Lord. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
verses.sm: Ma sa toe to Eva ma fanauina lona uso o Apelu. Ma sa faalogo Apelu i le siufofoga o le Alii. Ma o Apelu sa leoleo mamoe, ae o Kaino sa galueaiina le fanua.

w.en: to the voice of the Lord;

verses.en: And Cain loved Satan more than God. And Satan commanded him, saying: Make an offering unto the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma sa sili atu le alofa o Kaino ia Satani nai lo le Atua. Ma sa faatonu o ia e Satani, ua fai atu: Fai se taulaga i le Alii.

verses.en: And in process of time it came to pass that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma i le gasologa o taimi, sa oo ina aumai e Kaino mai fua o le eleele se taulaga i le Alii.

verses.en: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock, and of the fat thereof. And the Lord had respect unto Abel, and to his offering;
verses.sm: Ma o Apelu, sa aumai foi e ia mai ulua’i manu o lana lafu, ma le ga’o o i ai. Ma sa aloaia e le Alii Apelu, ma lana taulaga;

verses.en: But unto Cain, and to his offering, he had not respect. Now Satan knew this, and it pleased him. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.
verses.sm: Ae o Kaino, ma lana taulaga, sa lē aloaia e le Alii. O lenei sa iloa e Satani lenei mea, ma sa fiafia i ai o ia. Ma sa ita tele Kaino, ma sa faa’ū’ū o ia.

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Cain: Why art thou wroth? Why is thy countenance fallen?
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii ia Kaino: Aisea ua e ita ai? Aisea ua e faa’ū’ū ai?

verses.en: If thou doest well, thou shalt be accepted. And if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door, and Satan desireth to have thee; and except thou shalt hearken unto my commandments, I will deliver thee up, and it shall be unto thee according to his desire. And thou shalt rule over him;
verses.sm: Afai e te faia mea lelei, e talia oe. Ma afai e te lē faia mea lelei, ua taoto mai le agasala i le faitotoa, ma ua manao Satani ia maua oe; ma vagana ua e faalogo mai i a’u poloaiga, o le a Ou tuu atu oe, ma o le a faia ia te oe e tusa ma lona manao. Ma o le a e pule ia te ia;

verses.en: For from this time forth thou shalt be the father of his lies; thou shalt be called Perdition; for thou wast also before the world.
verses.sm: Aua e mai le taimi nei i luma o le a avea oe ma tamā o ana pepelo; o le a ta’ua oe o le Malaia; aua sa e faapea foi ae le’i i ai le lalolagi.

verses.en: And it shall be said in time to come—That these abominations were had from Cain; for he rejected the greater counsel which was had from God; and this is a cursing which I will put upon thee, except thou repent.
verses.sm: Ma o le a faapea ane i taimi e oo mai— E faapea o nei mea inosia na mai ia Kaino; ona sa teena e ia le fautuaga sili na mai le Atua; ma o se fetuu lenei o le a Ou tuu i luga o oe, vagana ai ua e salamo.

verses.en: And Cain was wroth, and listened not any more to the voice of the Lord, neither to Abel, his brother, who walked in holiness before the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma sa ita Kaino, ma sa lē toe faalogo i le siufofoga o le Alii, po o Apelu, lona uso, o lē na savali i le paia i luma o le Alii.

verses.en: And Adam and his wife mourned before the Lord, because of Cain and his brethren.
verses.sm: Ma sa faanoanoa Atamu ma lana ava i luma o le Alii, ona o Kaino ma ona uso.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Cain took one of his brothers' daughters to wife, and they loved Satan more than God.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ave e Kaino se tasi o afafine o ona uso ma ana ava, ma sa sili atu lo laua alolofa ia Satani nai lo le Atua.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And Satan said unto Cain: Swear unto me by thy throat, and if thou tell it thou shalt die; and swear thy brethren by their heads, and by the living God, that they tell it not; for if they tell it, they shall surely die; and this that thy father may not know it; and this day I will deliver thy brother Abel into thine hands.
verses.sm: Ma sa fai atu Satani ia Kaino: Tauto mai ia te a’u i lou fa’aī, ma afai e te ta’ua o le a e oti; ma ia faatauto ou uso i o latou ulu, ma i le Atua soifua, ia latou le ta’ua; ona afai latou te ta’ua, o le a latou feoti lava; ma o lenei ina ia lē iloa e lou tamā; ma o le aso nei o le a ou tuu atu ai lou uso o Apelu i ou lima.

verses.en: And Satan sware unto Cain that he would do according to his commands. And all these things were done in secret.
verses.sm: Ma sa tauto Satani ia Kaino o le a faia e ia e tusa ma ana poloaiga. Ma o nei mea uma sa faia faalilolilo.

verses.en: And Cain said: Truly I am Mahan, the master of this great secret, that I may murder and get gain. Wherefore Cain was called Master Mahan, and he gloried in his wickedness.
verses.sm: Ma sa fai mai Kaino: E moni lava o a’u o Mahana, o le pule o lenei mealilo tele, ina ia mafai ona ou fasioti ma maua mea. O le mea lea na ta’ua ai Kaino o Mahana Pule, ma sa mitamita o ia i lana amioleaga.

verses.en: And Cain went into the field, and Cain talked with Abel, his brother. And it came to pass that while they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel, his brother, and slew him.
verses.sm: Ma sa alu atu Kaino i le fanua, ma sa talanoa Kaino ma Apelu, lona uso. Ma sa oo a’o i ai i laua i le fanua, sa tulai atu Kaino e faasaga ia Apelu, lona uso, ma fasioti ia te ia.

verses.en: And Cain gloried in that which he had done, saying: I am free; surely the flocks of my brother falleth into my hands.
verses.sm: Ma sa mitamita Kaino i le mea ua ia faia, ua fai mai: Ua ou saoloto; e moni lava o lafu a lo’u uso ua i o’u lima.

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Cain: Where is Abel, thy brother? And he said: I know not. Am I my brother's keeper?
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii ia Kaino: O fea Apelu, lou uso? Ma sa fai atu o ia: Ou te lē iloa. O a’u ea o se leoleo o lo’u uso?

verses.en: And the Lord said: What hast thou done? The voice of thy brother's blood cries unto me from the ground.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii: O le a le mea ua e faia? Ua tagi mai ia te a’u le leo o le toto o lou uso mai le eleele.

verses.en: And now thou shalt be cursed from the earth which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei o le a fetuuina oe mai le eleele ua faamaga mai lona gutu e tali le toto o lou uso mai lou lima.

verses.en: When thou tillest the ground it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength. A fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.
verses.sm: A e galueaiina le eleele o le a lē tuu mai e ia ia te oe lona malosi mai le taimi nei ma le agai i luma. O le a avea oe o se tagata solasola ma maumausolo i le lalolagi.

verses.en: And Cain said unto the Lord: Satan tempted me because of my brother's flocks. And I was wroth also; for his offering thou didst accept and not mine; my punishment is greater than I can bear.
verses.sm: Ma sa fai atu Kaino i le Alii: Sa faaosoosoina a’u e Satani ona o lafu a lo’u uso. Ma sa ou ita foi; ona sa e talia lana taulaga ae lē o la’u; ua tele atu lo’u faasalaga nai lo le mea ou te lavatia.

verses.en: Behold thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the Lord, and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, that he that findeth me will slay me, because of mine iniquities, for these things are not hid from the Lord.
verses.sm: Faauta ua e tuli ese a’u i le aso nei mai luma o fofoga o le Alii, ma o le a natia a’u mai i ou fofoga; ma o le a avea a’u ma tagata solasola ma maumausolo i le lalolagi; ma o le a oo mai foi o ia o lē e mauaina a’u o le a fasioti ia te a’u, ona o a’u amioletonu, ona o ia mea ua lē natia mai le Alii.

w.en: And shall come to pass also

verses.en: And I the Lord said unto him: Whosoever slayeth thee, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And I the Lord set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.
verses.sm: Ma o A’u o le Alii na fai atu ia te ia: Ai se e faaoo le oti ia te oe, o le a faafitu ona tauimasui ia te ia. Ma o A’u o le Alii sa tuuina se faailoga i luga o Kaino, ne’i faaoo le oti ia te ia e se e maua o ia.

verses.en: And Cain was shut out from the presence of the Lord, and with his wife and many of his brethren dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.
verses.sm: Ma sa tapunia ese Kaino mai luma o le Alii, ma sa mau faatasi ma lana ava ma le toatele o ona uso i le laueleele o Nota, i le itu i sasa’e o Etena.

w.en: from the presence of the Lord.

verses.en: And Cain knew his wife, and she conceived and bare Enoch, and he also begat many sons and daughters. And he builded a city, and he called the name of the city after the name of his son, Enoch.
verses.sm: Ma sa iloa e Kaino lana ava, ma sa to o ia ma fanauina Enoka, ma sa fanauina foi e ia atalii ma afafine e toatele. Ma sa fausia e ia se aai, ma sa ta’u e ia le igoa o le aai i le igoa o lona atalii, o Enoka.

verses.en: And unto Enoch was born Irad, and other sons and daughters. And Irad begat Mahujael, and other sons and daughters. And Mahujael begat Methusael, and other sons and daughters. And Methusael begat Lamech.
verses.sm: Ma sa fanauina Irata ia Enoka, ma isi atalii ma afafine. Ma sa fanaua e Irata Mekuala, ma isi atalii ma afafine. Ma sa fanaua Metusaeli e Mekuala, ma isi atalii ma afafine. Ma sa fanaua e Metusaeli o Lameko.

verses.en: And Lamech took unto himself two wives; the name of one being Adah, and the name of the other, Zillah.
verses.sm: Ma sa ave e Lameko ia te ia ni ava e toalua; o le igoa o le tasi o Ata, ma o le igoa o le isi, o Sela.

verses.en: And Adah bare Jabal; he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and they were keepers of cattle; and his brother's name was Jubal, who was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.
verses.sm: Ma sa fanaua Iapalu e Ata; o ia o le tamā o e e mau i faleie, ma sa avea i latou ma tagata tausi lafu manu; ma o le igoa o lona uso o Iupalu, o lē o le tamā o i latou uma o e ta kitara ma okeni.

verses.en: And Zillah, she also bare Tubal Cain, an instructor of every artificer in brass and iron. And the sister of Tubal Cain was called Naamah.
verses.sm: Ma o Sela, sa fanauina foi e ia Tupalu Kaino, o se tufuga o mea uma e fai i apamemea ma le u’amea. Ma o le tuafafine o Tupalu Kaino o Naama.

verses.en: And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah: Hear my voice, ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech; for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.
verses.sm: Ma sa fai atu Lameko i ana ava, o Ata ma Sela: Faalogo mai i lo’u leo, oulua ava a Lameko, faalogo mai i la’u tautala atu; ona ua ou fasiotia se tagata i lo’u manu’a, ma o se taule’ale’a i lo’u tiga.

verses.en: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech shall be seventy and seven fold;
verses.sm: Afai e faafitu ona tauimasui o Kaino, e moni o Lameko o le a faafitugafulu ma le fitu;

verses.en: For Lamech having entered into a covenant with Satan, after the manner of Cain, wherein he became Master Mahan, master of that great secret which was administered unto Cain by Satan; and Irad, the son of Enoch, having known their secret, began to reveal it unto the sons of Adam;
verses.sm: Ona sa ulu atu Lameko i se feagaiga ma Satani, e pei ona faia e Kaino, lea na avea ai o ia ma Mahana Pule, o le pule o lena mealilo tele na tuuina mai e Satani ia Kaino; ma o Irata, le atalii o Enoka, ina ua iloa e ia la latou mealilo, sa amata ona faaali atu e ia i atalii o Atamu;

verses.en: Wherefore Lamech, being angry, slew him, not like unto Cain, his brother Abel, for the sake of getting gain, but he slew him for the oath's sake.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, ona o le ita, na fasioti ai e Lameko o ia, e lē pei ona faia e Kaino, i lona uso o Apelu, ina ia maua ai mea; ae sa fasiotia Irata e Lameko ona o le tautoga.

verses.en: For, from the days of Cain, there was a secret combination, and their works were in the dark, and they knew every man his brother.
verses.sm: Ona, mai i aso o Kaino, sa i ai se pulega faalilolilo, ma o a latou galuega sa faia i le pouliuli, ma sa latou iloa tagata taitoatasi o o latou uso.

verses.en: Wherefore the Lord cursed Lamech, and his house, and all them that had covenanted with Satan; for they kept not the commandments of God, and it displeased God, and he ministered not unto them, and their works were abominations, and began to spread among all the sons of men. And it was among the sons of men.
verses.sm: O le mea lea na fetuu ai Lameko e le Alii, ma lona aiga, ma i latou uma o e na osifeagaiga ma Satani; ona sa latou lē tausia poloaiga a le Atua, ma sa lē fiafia ai le Atua, ma sa lē auauna mai o ia ia te i latou, ma o a latou galuega sa o ni mea inosia ia, ma sa amata ona salalau atu i totonu o atalii uma o tagata. Ma sa i ai ia mea i totonu o atalii o tagata.

verses.en: And among the daughters of men these things were not spoken, because that Lamech had spoken the secret unto his wives, and they rebelled against him, and declared these things abroad, and had not compassion;
verses.sm: Ma o ia mea sa lē tautalagia i totonu o afafine o tagata, ona sa ta’u e Lameko le mealilo i ana ava, ma sa la’ua fouvale e faasaga ia te ia, ma sa ta’u atu ia mea faalauaitele, ma sa lē i ai le agaalofa;

verses.en: Wherefore Lamech was despised, and cast out, and came not among the sons of men, lest he should die.
verses.sm: O le mea lea na inosia ai Lameko, ma tuli ese i fafo, ma lē sau ai i totonu o atalii o tagata, ne’i oti o ia.

verses.en: And thus the works of darkness began to prevail among all the sons of men.
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona amata ona salalau galuega o le pouliuli i totonu o atalii uma o tagata.

verses.en: And God cursed the earth with a sore curse, and was angry with the wicked, with all the sons of men whom he had made;
verses.sm: Ma sa fetuu e le Atua le lalolagi i se fetuu tiga, ma sa toatama’i i e amioleaga, atoa ma atalii uma o tagata o e na faia e ia;

verses.en: For they would not hearken unto his voice, nor believe on his Only Begotten Son, even him whom he declared should come in the meridian of time, who was prepared from before the foundation of the world.
verses.sm: Aua sa latou lē faalogo i lona siufofoga, pe talitonu i lona Atalii Pele e Toatasi, o ia lava na ia folafola mai o le a afio mai i le vaeluaga o taimi, o lē na saunia a o le i faavaeina le lalolagi.

verses.en: And thus the Gospel began to be preached, from the beginning, being declared by holy angels sent forth from the presence of God, and by his own voice, and by the gift of the Holy Ghost.
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona amata ona talai atu o le Talalelei, mai le amataga, ua folafola atu e agelu paia ua auina atu mai luma o le Atua, ma i lona lava siufofoga, ma i le meaalofa o le Agaga Paia.

verses.en: And thus all things were confirmed unto Adam, by an holy ordinance, and the Gospel preached, and a decree sent forth, that it should be in the world, until the end thereof; and thus it was. Amen.
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona faamautuina o mea uma ia Atamu, i se sauniga paia, ma talai atu ai le Talalelei, ma auina atu se poloaiga, e tatau ona i ai i le lalolagi, seia oo i lona iuga; ma sa faapea lava. Amene.
